WITH product_shares AS (
  SELECT product_id,
         COUNT(*) AS line_count,
         CAST(COUNT(*) AS DECIMAL(19,8)) / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER () AS share
  FROM Order_Items
  GROUP BY product_id
),
classified AS (
  SELECT line_count,
         share,
         AVG(share) OVER () AS average_share
  FROM product_shares
)
SELECT SUM(line_count) AS combined_count,
       AVG(share) AS average_share,
       AVG(share - average_share) AS average_excess_share
FROM classified
WHERE share > average_share;
